description: This file defines the IQueueAdapterReceiver interface in the Orleans.Streams namespace, which manages message batch reception from a message queue partition, including initialization, message retrieval, delivery notification, and shutdown.

classes.name: IQueueAdapterReceiver
classes.description: Interface for receiving message batches from a message queue partition, with methods for initialization, message retrieval, delivery notification, and shutdown.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the receiver with a specified timeout.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of message batches from the queue, up to maxCount.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Notifies that the specified message batches have been delivered to consumers.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the receiver and performs cleanup, with a specified timeout.
